note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped (scripts/qa-cover-recipes.mjs re-renders it and fails when median d or moving leave +-15 %, seamLocal leaves TARGET or bytes pass 2 MiB). Measured 2026-10-20 on headless Chrome's software rung and libwebp 1.6.0.

treatment.request: A README motion cover for LitGravity that shows work moving through gates.
treatment.idea: Dots lap three rings and every crossing at the gate lights the next cell of a ledger under the name.
treatment.recipeReason: A small system beside a still name shows checking without words.
treatment.beat: Each crossing at the gate lights the next ledger cell.

layers.slow: Dashed ring overlays turn a quarter lap per loop.
layers.mid: The core breathes once per loop and rings on every bar.
layers.beat: Gate flashes and dot pulses at each crossing; ledger cells light and decay.

system.rule: One orbit rule with integer laps per ring.
system.copies: Eight dots on three rings and sixteen ledger cells.
system.offset: Each dot's start angle k / n on its ring.

treatment.ambition: The ledger and the gates keep a steady pulse while the word stays perfectly still.
